tools.title: Pipeline Health A[i]gent Tool
tools.description: Turns raw hiring funnel data into decision-ready diagnostics.

hero.headline: Stop debating numbers. Start fixing bottlenecks.
hero.subline: Pipeline Health A[i]gent is an AI tool that turns raw hiring funnel data into decision-ready diagnostics so recruiters know what is broken, why, and how to fix it in real time.

tools.purpose: Hiring decisions fail when teams don’t trust or understand the numbers. Pipeline Health exists to remove ambiguity and make funnel performance explainable — not debatable.
whatBreaks: Funnel performance is debated instead of understood.
Actionable dashboards create noise, not decisions.
Bottlenecks are discovered late, after damage is done.
KPI truth gets hidden in performative actions instead of operational reality.
Metrics lose credibility and trust erodes — which slows execution everywhere.
whatItDoes: Diagnoses pass-through drop-offs by stage (and flags abnormal patterns).
Detects constraints (capacity, volume, timing mismatches) before teams feel them.
Surfaces likely causes and recommended next actions (operator-facing, not analytics speak).
Executes Tier-1 actions automatically when pre-approved (agenda updates, alerts, nudges).
tools.outcomes: Faster execution. Cleaner decisions. Fewer stalled roles.
whereItFits: Downstream of Hiring & Mobility signals: interviews, offers, time-in-stage, pass-through, SLAs.
Upstream of Planning, Innovation, and Governance: makes drift and decay visible early.
Feeds Chief A[i]gent: thresholds for autonomy and escalation signals.

title: Screening A[i]gent
description: Decision support that surfaces evidence and risk during screening—without turning evaluation into a black box.

title: Sourcing Quality
description: Defines evidence standards and signal checks so inbound, outbound, and referrals are evaluated consistently.

title: Listening A[i]gent
description: Continuously captures qualitative feedback and turns narrative signals into usable, low-noise insight.

title: Workflow-First Operating Model
description: Explains how routing, SLAs, escalation paths, and automation fit together in an AI-native People Ops system.

title: Chief A[i]gent
description: The orchestration layer that governs autonomy—routing decisions, enforcing guardrails, and keeping humans in the loop.

title: Innovation A[i]gent
description: Routes ideas into action by checking institutional memory, structuring experiments, and ensuring closure.
